definitions.explanation: A small finch with a gray body, white cheeks, and a thick pink beak, popular in Japan as a hand-tamed pet bird.

examples.japanese: {文鳥|ぶんちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飼|か}っている→飼う：08151_kau⟧。
{文鳥|ぶんちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}って→乗る：00511_noru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The Java sparrow perched on my hand.

examples.japanese: {文鳥|ぶんちょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{懐|なつ}く→懐く：17463_natsuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦ペット→ペット：02959_petto⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Java sparrows become very attached to people, so they have long been popular as pets.

notes:
A small songbird kept as a pet in Japan since the Edo period. The white-and-gray ({並文鳥|なみぶんちょう}) and all-white ({白文鳥|はくぶんちょう}) varieties are most common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {文鳥|ぶんちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飼|か}う→飼う：08151_kau⟧: to keep a Java sparrow
- {手|て}{乗|の}り{文鳥|ぶんちょう}: a hand-tamed Java sparrow

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦インコ→インコ：18655_inko⟧: parakeet — another popular small pet bird
- ⟦{十姉妹|じゅうしまつ}→十姉妹：28266_juushimatsu⟧: society finch — a small finch often bred alongside 文鳥
